module TopModule (
  input [2:0] vec,
  output [2:0] outv,
  output o2,
  output o1,
  output o0
);

  assign outv = ~vec; // Bitwise NOT of vec
  assign o2 = vec[0] & vec[1]; // AND of first two bits of vec
  assign o1 = vec[1] | vec[2]; // OR of last two bits of vec
  assign o0 = vec[0] ^ vec[2]; // XOR of first and last bits of vec
  
endmodule
